data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'Awd', meaning 'to help or aid'. In Islamic history, Aydeen is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for his unwavering support and assistance. The name Aydeen carries the meaning “Help, Assistance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aydeen usually hope their child will grow to embody help, assistance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
